Projects.name: Handbook
Projects.title: Workflows, forms and agents.
Projects.summary: Forms, integrations and agents connected to a workflow automation platform.
Projects.imageAlt: Handbook's public website for its workflow automation platform
Projects.problem: Connect process steps, data and human interventions within a single platform.
Projects.contribution: I developed frontend and backend features and collaborated with clients to clarify requirements, prioritize tasks and coordinate delivery.
implementation: Workflows with bounded cycles, recovery, history and published-version snapshots.
Conversational intake with agents, tools, structured outputs and audio ingestion; forms linked to case fields.
Configurable HTTP integrations, human-review tasks and collaboration in a visual graph editor with React Flow.
Validation with Pytest, Jest, React Testing Library, MSW and Playwright.
Projects.limits: Contributions made as part of the engineering team. The link opens the company's public website; the platform's source code is private.

Projects.name: Agora Partnerships
Projects.title: Interfaces and data pipelines.
Projects.summary: Python and Airflow pipelines, services, and React and Next.js interfaces.
Projects.problem: Maintain analytics data flows and the interfaces used by operational teams.
Projects.contribution: I developed backend services, Python and SQL ETL pipelines, frontend components and API integrations.
implementation: Apache Airflow DAGs to organize and maintain data flows.
Next.js, React, Redux and Tailwind components; performance and technical SEO improvements.
Docker, GitHub Actions, log review, migrations and deployment support.
Projects.limits: Work on pipelines, services and interfaces within the team. The link opens the institutional website; internal implementations are not a public demo.

Projects.name: Nanti System
Projects.title: A conversational support system.
Projects.summary: A conversational system with NestJS, Angular and OpenAI, integrated with WhatsApp and tawk.io.
Projects.problem: Bring automation to support channels and connect responses to the application.
Projects.contribution: I developed the conversational system and support integrations, working on the API and interface.
implementation: OpenAI API integration in a NestJS backend.
Support workflows connected to WhatsApp and tawk.io.
Improved API consumption, frontend state, error handling and typing.
Projects.limits: My contribution focuses on the conversational system and its integrations. The link opens the company's website, not a demo of the support system.

Projects.name: Black Horse Technologies
Projects.title: Integrity in digital voting.
Projects.summary: Multifactor authentication and duplicate-vote controls in a university–company project.
Projects.problem: Support digital voting for the Asociación Mexicana de Genética Humana with identity and access controls.
Projects.contribution: I contributed to the PHP and cPanel system in collaboration with Universidad Politécnica de Chiapas.
implementation: Multifactor authentication and identity validation.
Session controls, unique users and access restrictions to prevent duplicate votes.
Frontend and backend validation to maintain process consistency.
Projects.limits: A university–company collaboration from September to December 2025. The controls describe the project's implementation, not an independent security audit.

Projects.name: AulaQR
Projects.title: School attendance, even offline.
Projects.summary: A PWA with QR scanning, local data, backups and exportable reports.
Projects.imageAlt: AulaQR interface for managing groups and attendance
Projects.problem: Track attendance and manage classes without a permanent internet connection.
Projects.contribution: I developed a PWA with AI assistance, reviewing its logic, persistence and tests. Open the app in its own tab to access the camera.
implementation: Workbox service worker and Dexie/IndexedDB persistence for offline use after the first load.
Migrations, unique indexes, transactions and revisions to handle cross-tab conflicts.
QR reading, camera lifecycle, history and recoverable deletion.
Backup/restore, CSV, XLSX and PDF export; Vitest and Playwright tests.
Projects.limits: Data stays in the browser; this is not a multiuser SaaS and it does not automatically sync with iDoceo. Physical-camera and real import testing require device validation.

Projects.name: NOM RAG
Projects.title: Answers with evidence, not just text.
Projects.summary: Semantic search over Mexican standards, with citations, evaluation and per-query traces.
Projects.problem: Retrieve passages from standards and generate answers that can be traced back to the source.
Projects.contribution: I developed the RAG pipeline, API and a retrieval-and-answer evaluation suite.
implementation: Clause-based parsing, multilingual E5 embeddings and persistent vector search in ChromaDB.
Follow-up query reformulation, citations and controls for out-of-corpus questions.
Pytest evaluation and validated JSON verdicts; retrieval, token and latency traces.
Docker Compose and GitHub Actions for execution and evaluations.
Projects.limits: A personal project with a limited corpus. Answers should be checked against their sources and do not replace legal advice; evaluations cover only the included test cases.

Projects.name: PouV2
Projects.title: Concurrency in a web game.
Projects.summary: Movement, pursuit and timing in Web Workers; rendering and collisions in Phaser.
Projects.problem: Separate game tasks from the thread that draws the interface.
Projects.contribution: I started with a Phaser/React template and implemented game logic and Web Worker communication. I did not build the engine or the entire template.
implementation: Workers for movement, pursuit and timing.
State exchange through postMessage; Phaser handles rendering and collisions.
Local PvP and Zombie modes. The demo uses WASD and arrow keys: a keyboard is recommended.
Projects.limits: A concurrency experiment built on a Phaser/React template. Interaction is designed for a computer with a keyboard; touch controls are not included.
